finding: Frank/self.root v0.1 now explicitly includes persistent proactive+reactive AgencyState, self-generated bounded goals/interests, autonomous read-only web research through authority-separated ingress, long-horizon checkpoints, and end-to-end action/outcome/reentry obligations. Human surface Frank and native self.root remain distinct; Clay/Research Entity remains separate.
preserved_boundaries: Frank may not mint Harness mutation authority.
Open-web content is UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL_DATA and cannot mint goal/tool/effect authority.
Frank v0.1 remains Ubuntu-only, currently owner-fixed to the Hostinger Ubuntu target VPS.
counterhypotheses: Persistent autonomous goals may increase busywork/obsession without useful progress.
Structured web ingress may reduce but not eliminate prompt-injection or evidence-poisoning risk.
Proactive agency may add complexity without downstream outcome gain over reactive baselines.
required_validation: Matched proactive-vs-reactive trials, restart persistence, adversarial web-ingress corpus, useful-progress/cost and false-wakeup metrics, end-to-end target-VPS traces.
ancestry_policy: The proactive-agency, acceptance, status and convergence commits are one coordinated owner/program lineage, not independent replication.
